supplements.title: In silico and in vitro study of the proapoptotic, autophagic and antitumor effects of cirsimaritin and humulene in hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Two natural compounds, cirsimaritin and humulene, kill liver cancer cells by triggering cell death and autophagy while protecting normal cells.

supplements.title: Anticancer potential, antioxidant activity, chemical content, and enzyme inhibitory properties of Inula aschersoniana Janka, supported by an integrated network pharmacology study.
supplements.summary: Inula aschersoniana plant extract kills breast and colon cancer cells while showing antioxidant activity and enzyme inhibition properties.

supplements.title: Galangin Overcomes Gefitinib and Sotorasib Resistance in Non-small Cell Lung Cancer by Inhibiting Efferocytosis.
supplements.summary: Galangin, a natural compound, restores lung cancer cell sensitivity to two major drugs by blocking a resistance pathway involving immune cells.

supplements.title: Activation of MTCH2 by Momordin Ic Prevents Colitis and Colitis-Associated Colorectal Cancer Through Rescuing the Mitochondrial Dysfunction of Macrophage.
supplements.summary: Momordin Ic prevents colorectal cancer by restoring immune cell mitochondrial function and reducing inflammation through the SENP1/MTCH2 pathway.

supplements.title: Exercise Metabolic Memory Halts Pathological Cardiac Hypertrophy via PDK4.
supplements.summary: Exercise creates lasting metabolic changes in the heart that prevent harmful enlargement and heart failure through a protein called PDK4.

supplements.title: Morin attenuates trimethyltin-induced hippocampal neurotoxicity in male rats by mitigating oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis.
supplements.summary: Morin, a natural compound, protected rat brain cells from toxin-induced damage by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death.

supplements.title: Evaluating oral nutritional support and the nutritional risk scores in ICI-treated metastatic solid tumours.
supplements.summary: Oral nutritional supplements may improve survival in metastatic cancer patients receiving immunotherapy by addressing malnutrition.

supplements.title: Updates on Mediterranean diet and health status: active ingredients and pharmacological mechanisms.
supplements.summary: The Mediterranean diet reduces cancer and disease risk through anti-inflammatory compounds like polyphenols and healthy fats.

supplements.title: Dietary Fat Content Influences PanIN Progression and Pancreatic Cancer Development in Mice.
supplements.summary: High-fat and ketogenic diets accelerate pancreatic cancer development and progression in mice with Kras mutations.

supplements.title: Targeting Nuclear Factor-κB1 With Andrographolide - Novel Strategy to Inhibit Vascular Lesions and Aneurysm Formation in Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm.
supplements.summary: Andrographolide, a natural compound targeting NF-κB1, shows promise in preventing abdominal aortic aneurysm progression and formation.

supplements.title: Pathophysiology and multi-target prevention strategies for cyclophosphamide-induced bladder injury.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified how cyclophosphamide damages the bladder and propose multiple prevention strategies targeting inflammation and oxidative stress to protect patients.

supplements.title: Creatine uptake promotes dendritic cell activation and enhances antitumor immunity.
supplements.summary: Creatine supplementation activates immune cells to fight melanoma tumors by boosting their energy and anti-cancer responses.

supplements.title: Quercetin Chemoprevention for Squamous Cell Carcinoma in Patients With Fanconi Anemia
supplements.summary: A study tested whether quercetin supplement can prevent squamous cell carcinoma in Fanconi anemia patients.

supplements.title: A Phase I/II, Open Label Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of BLEX 404Oral Liquid Combined With Pemetrexed + Cisplatin Therapy in Patients With Advanced Inoperable or Metastatic EGFR Wild-type Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Patients
supplements.summary: Researchers are testing whether BLEX 404, a mushroom extract, combined with chemotherapy improves survival in advanced lung cancer patients.

supplements.title: Aging-associated decline of phosphatidylcholine synthesis is a malleable trigger of natural mitochondrial aging.
supplements.summary: Declining phosphatidylcholine synthesis drives mitochondrial aging; dietary supplementation restores function and metabolic health in aging organisms.

off_label.title: Inhibition of Focal Adhesion Restricts Chemoresistance in Pancreatic Cancer by Targeting SLC7A11 Mediated Ferroptosis.

off_label.title: Repurposing drugs for treating the neurobehavioral manifestations of PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome.

off_label.title: Pathophysiology and multi-target prevention strategies for cyclophosphamide-induced bladder injury.

off_label.title: Cisplatin-induced renal toxicity: an integrated view of molecular pathways and emerging therapeutic targets-a comprehensive review.

off_label.title: White adipose atrophy exacerbates cold stress and accelerates aging in male mice.

off_label.title: Nicotinamide N-methyltransferase as a therapeutic target in taxane-resistant castration-resistant prostate cancer.

off_label.title: mTOR-driven integrin β4-enriched extracellular vesicles from lenvatinib-resistant hepatocellular carcinoma fuel lung metastasis via fibroblast-niche formation.
